single_purpose.fr: Détecter et signaler les liens de phishing.

remote_code.justification: All JavaScript is in the package and readable (not minified); the build refuses eval, new Function, importScripts and HTML injection. Optional model updates are data (decision trees in JSON), verified with an Ed25519 key built into the extension, never code.

permissions.activeTab: Read the address of the current tab only when the user clicks the PhishGuard icon, to analyse it on the device.
permissions.contextMenus: Add the "Check this link with PhishGuard" entry to the right-click menu on links.
permissions.storage: Keep the user's settings and trusted sites on the device, and the results of the analyses they asked for in session memory.
permissions.https://mail.google.com/*: Analyse on the device the links and sender of the single message open in Gmail, and show an alert there when a link is suspicious; nothing is stored or sent.
permissions.tabs: Read the address of each opened page to analyse it on the device, only if the user turns on automatic analysis; released when it is turned off.
permissions.https://*/*: Reach the PhishGuard server that the user typed and authorised, for online analysis or error reports, or download the signed model updates from the project's GitHub releases if the user turns them on; only those exact hosts are requested, at the moment the option is turned on.
permissions.http://localhost/*: Reach a PhishGuard server running on the user's own computer, under the same conditions.
permissions.http://127.0.0.1/*: Reach a PhishGuard server running on the user's own computer, under the same conditions.

data_usage.$comment: Formulaire « Pratiques de confidentialité » : le développeur ne reçoit aucune donnée. Les options en ligne, désactivées par défaut, parlent à un serveur choisi par l'utilisateur, jamais à l'auteur (docs/extension-privacy.md, section 3).
